about_short_description.short_description: Inth offers an observability platform that provides open-source consent management standard for users and AI agents.

product.name: Consent Management Platform
product.description: A developer-focused system for managing user privacy consent, enabling compliance with privacy laws through customizable consent banners and real-time consent verification.

product.name: Consent Manager React Library
product.description: A React-based library providing components and hooks to integrate consent management features like cookie banners and consent status checks into web applications.

product.name: Self-Hosted Consent Backend
product.description: A backend solution that allows organizations to store and manage user consent data on their own infrastructure, ensuring data sovereignty and integration flexibility.

product.name: Offline Consent Storage Mode
product.description: A client-side only consent management mode that stores user consent data locally without requiring backend infrastructure.
